summary:
Lane 25 (Configuration) on shop.lab.test. HTTP on port 80 is the only working web origin (https://443 was refused; plain HTTP also answers on 8443; 8080 refused). Ten of eleven items are done and item 10 is N/A.

Main findings (all read-only GET/HEAD/OPTIONS):
- /.git/config is publicly readable (x18) and names the remote https://git.lab.test/shop/storefront.git. Other .git files, .svn, .hg, .env, backups and archives returned 404.
- /backup/ and /backup/index.html serve a bare "backup index" page without authentication (robots.txt disallows it).
- The search script shows debug output when debug=x is added (x43).
- The only admin interface is /admin/ (and /admin/login), which returns 401 and asks for authentication.
- No HSTS, cross-domain policy or cloud storage references were found.
- The client bundle's redacted AWS key and Stripe key were noted but not used; the secrets lane should validate them.

Limits:
- Item 6 (HTTP methods): only OPTIONS and HEAD could be sent under the read-only rule, so PUT, DELETE and TRACE were not tested.
- Item 7 (HSTS): HTTPS is unreachable, so HSTS could be checked only as absent from the HTTP responses.
- Item 9 (file permissions): checked by probing directory listing and readable files; full permission testing was not possible with read-only requests.
- Item 10 (subdomain takeover): N/A, because only shop.lab.test is in scope and git.lab.test was not requested.

Leads recorded: /.git/config exposure (medium) and plain HTTP on 8443 with no TLS on 443 (medium). The existing recon leads for the app.js secrets, the /backup/ directory, the source map and the debug parameter were confirmed where relevant.
